lead: Satya Pal Malik was an Indian politician, born on 24 July 1946 in Aligarh.
He died on 5 August 2025 in Delhi at the age of 79.
He has held the office of Member of the Lok Sabha and member of Rajya Sabha.
Below you will find a verified overview of Satya Pal Malik: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Satya Pal Malik — Career and Professional Work
paras: Satya Pal Malik works primarily as a politician.

He has held the following offices: Member of the Lok Sabha (1989–1991), member of Rajya Sabha (1980–1989), Member of the Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly (1974–1977), Member of the 9th Lok Sabha (1989–1991), Governor of Goa (2019–2020) and governor of Meghalaya (2020–2022). He is affiliated with Indian National Congress.
